description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Six geographical aggregations of the Pierce County Impact Index provide infrastructure-access indicators, including transit stops per hour, transit and internet access, drinking-water non-compliance, heavy-traffic proximity and access to community facilities. The source describes z-scores relative to county means, category averages and an overall index. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for capacity planning studies. Zipcode, school-district, council-district, block-group, city and census-tract views are one index resource. It combines infrastructure indicators with wider social indicators; scores are relative estimates, not measured network capacity. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
